measurementPolicy: Wall-clock reported by bounded commands is the only quantitative proxy. It excludes unobservable model reasoning, provider billing, user wait time and time between commands.

stageEffort.why: Read durable project rules, frozen blind/strategy diagnosis, current CONTENT and historical batch contracts.
Three full SOURCE reads, three prepared requests, response validation and one failed-closed evidence correction.
Twelve HTTPS documents, three controlled probes, three Researcher requests and three validated packets.
Three drafts, one fail-closed PHP-language contract correction, then nine independently executed examples.
Three full Critic reviews passed without revision; three deterministic candidate gates copied exact reviewed Markdown.
Vitest 362/362 PASS (16.59 s), Astro check PASS (22.14 s) and Astro/Pagefind build PASS (9.90 s).
Vitest 362/362 PASS (18.25 s), Astro check PASS (23.30 s) and Astro/Pagefind build PASS (10.00 s) after documentation closure.

repeatedContext: Each topic retains request, response, source bundle, probe, packet, acceptance, Writer request/response, draft, execution, Critic request/response/review, revision and candidate artifacts.
The repeated provenance is useful in this proof-of-work batch; it is also the main contributor to 75 LAB files for three short candidates.

recommendations.proposal: Keep SOURCE deep reads at one contextual record per foundation topic and research documents at the smallest authority-adequate set.
recommendations.reason: Three deep reads and four documents per topic produced valid candidates with no unresolved research question.

recommendations.proposal: Measure request payload sizes and duplicated byte ranges before the next three-topic batch; record only a batch manifest experiment if duplication becomes a review problem.
recommendations.reason: This batch already records 824957 bytes but has no measured clone, review or replay slowdown.

recommendations.proposal: Reuse one tested runtime-execution helper by runtime family, while retaining one independent execution record per final draft.
recommendations.reason: The same safe mechanics executed nine examples; the proof required separate evidence, not three separate implementations.

recommendations.proposal: Consider content-addressed storage for immutable request/response payloads only after repeated measurements show LAB size or review friction.
recommendations.reason: The current evidence demonstrates duplication but not an operational bottleneck; traceability is still more valuable.

recommendations.proposal: Do not add automatic orchestration, a Dispatcher or a live multi-agent loop to save this batch's operator time.
recommendations.reason: The manual STOP gates caught two evidence/contract mismatches before invalid writes; removing them would trade a small time saving for weaker editorial control.

limitations: Levels are relative operational labels, not token, cost or energy measurements.
Observed command durations include local I/O and validation but not all in-session reasoning.
No optimization in this report has been implemented merely because it was proposed.
